text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
I shared the plan with Mihono Bourbon to 
hold a promotional live concert and 
training sessions for the Grand Live.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
They explained that this wasn't an order 
and they wanted Mihono Bourbon to 
participate of her own will, but she 
didn't seem to fully grasp it.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
If the day ever comes when Mihono Bourbon 
wants to participate of her own accord, 
I'll have her join us on stage.
